spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Can the other dashboards be trusted, and is monitoring itself sustainable?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/operations/observability-implementation.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Expected sites
spec.description:
Declared inventory survives the disappearance of a source. This is expected scope, not health.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Reporting sites
spec.description:
Distinct selected sites with fresh, successful evidence. Duplicate observations count once. Compare with Expected sites; partial results never certify fleet health.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Site evidence
spec.description:
Measured site evidence, including explicit Unknown when an expected site stops reporting. Independent site probes distinguish unreachable from unobserved.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Evidence age
spec.description:
Age of the last successful Kubernetes inventory observation. A recent Prometheus scrape alone does not prove the collector is seeing its upstream.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Collector source success
spec.description:
Collector-specific upstream success. HTTP scrape success can coexist with a blind collector.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Scrape failures

spec.expr: count by (k8s_cluster, job) (up{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"} == 0) or on (k8s_cluster) (0 * count by (k8s_cluster) (up{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.description:
Failed targets per job; a site showing 0 has none. Compare with declared inventory to detect targets that disappeared from discovery.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Active series
spec.description:
Head series/churn drive memory and disk growth. Add telemetry in bounded batches before raising resource limits.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Ingested samples
spec.description:
Ingested samples per second; compare before/after each collector family.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Retained blocks
spec.description:
Compressed blocks only; WAL/head, metadata and compaction scratch require additional disk.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Rule evaluation failures
spec.description:
Local alerts must remain independent of Grafana and the remote archive.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: SLO window coverage
spec.description:
How much of the 14 d SLO window each site's Prometheus holds. Below 100%, every availability on this tab covers only that share of its window: incomplete, not wrong.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: SLO availability
spec.description:
Good probe intervals over all of them in the window, per SLO and site (Pyrra, from slos.yaml). Targets are provisional until a full window exists; the Pyrra UI has burn rates.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: 28-day availability

spec.expr: label_replace(avg by (k8s_cluster) (avg_over_time(probe_success{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",observability_target="internet"}[28d])), "slo", "internet", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (k8s_cluster) (avg_over_time(probe_success{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",observability_target="ingress",name="hass"}[28d])), "slo", "home-assistant-path", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (k8s_cluster) (avg_over_time(probe_success{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",observability_target="ingress"}[28d])), "slo", "shared-vip-names", "", "") or label_replace(avg by (k8s_cluster) (avg_over_time(probe_success{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",observability_target="mqtt"}[28d])), "slo", "mqtt-broker", "", "")

spec.description:
Each SLO's indicator averaged over 28 days at query time, against the same targets as the 14-day Pyrra objectives. With the Global datasource the archive supplies the older weeks; read it with 28-day window coverage.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: 28-day window coverage

spec.expr: label_replace(clamp_max((time() - min by (k8s_cluster) (min_over_time(timestamp(probe_success{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",observability_target="internet"})[28d:1h]))) / 2419200, 1), "slo", "internet", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_max((time() - min by (k8s_cluster) (min_over_time(timestamp(probe_success{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",observability_target="ingress",name="hass"})[28d:1h]))) / 2419200, 1), "slo", "home-assistant-path", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_max((time() - min by (k8s_cluster) (min_over_time(timestamp(probe_success{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",observability_target="ingress"})[28d:1h]))) / 2419200, 1), "slo", "shared-vip-names", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_max((time() - min by (k8s_cluster) (min_over_time(timestamp(probe_success{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",observability_target="mqtt"})[28d:1h]))) / 2419200, 1), "slo", "mqtt-broker", "", "")

spec.description:
How much of the 28 days the chosen datasource holds for each indicator, from its earliest sample (hourly resolution). Below 100% the 28-day availability covers only that share; Local can't exceed 15 days.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Error budget left
spec.description:
Share of the allowed failures not yet used in the window. Negative means the objective is missed. Read with SLO window coverage.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Archive state
spec.description:
Local Garage on WSL-02 only. A loss of this endpoint makes archive history unavailable without invalidating retained local data.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Archive lag
spec.description:
Age of the newest sample the archive holds for each site, from the Compactor's block index. 1-3 h is normal (Prometheus cuts 2 h blocks once its head spans 3 h); over 4 h alerts.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Archive history
spec.description:
How far back the archive can answer for each site. Retention is 35 d; Pyrra's 28 d windows are incomplete until this passes 28 d.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Archive free space
spec.description:
Garage's data volume on WSL-02, shared with that node. Under 10% alerts.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Time since last upload
spec.description:
Since each site's sidecar last uploaded a block. Climbs to about 2 h between blocks and resets; Archive lag is the one to read.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Notification failures
spec.description:
Delivery failures. No active alerts is reassuring only when local evaluation, routing and external heartbeat delivery are functioning.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
